verdict.rationale: Financial Connections documents access to an account's current and available balances. It frames that balance data as a way to reduce underwriting risk, ties it to ACH Direct Debit payment collection, and emits a balance-refresh-complete event, so a developer can pull balance data around a payment. The evidence never shows an explicit on-demand or real-time balance endpoint or names NSF checks, and a community comment about 'only daily pulls' leaves freshness unclear. missing for 10: explicit real-time/on-demand balance refresh endpoint documentation, explicit NSF-check use case, independent hands-on corroboration of pre-payment balance checks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fetch a real-time balance for a connected account before initiating a payment — a documented balance endpoint intended for NSF and risk checks

citations.quote: Access an account’s current and available balances.
reduce underwriting risk with balances data
